task.cardTitle: CBM Live Integration: Harness Query Surface + Production Provider Wiring

objective: Evidence reseal (R1): supersede review bundle feb69523 with complete provenance + A1-A16 evidence for card AUTOLOOP-CBM-LIVE-INTEGRATION-1. Parent card identity preserved; Current/ untouched; verdict stays null.
designDecisions: ROOT-CAUSE (R4): CARD_IMPLEMENTATION_FILES rendered (none) because the FM-3 delta-v1 closeout inventory derives the current-card delta from TWO working-tree `git status --porcelain` snapshots (card-start baseline vs closeout) — it never diffs the baseline HEAD commit. The card-start baseline was captured at 2026-08-16T13:45:45Z at HEAD 251d9ae — i.e. AFTER the implementation commit 251d9ae (21:44:26 +0800) — so the 6 committed implementation files were clean at baseline and invisible to CURRENT_CARD_DELTA_PATHS. Generic gap: any card whose candidate is committed before the formal lifecycle run loses its implementation files from the bundle (no test asserts committed-changes attribution in the closeout path; change-inventory.mjs buildChangeInventory DOES diff base..HEAD but feeds only the review-job candidateIdentity, never the bundle).

PROVENANCE (R1-R3): base d36d016 (21:19:48 +0800) -> candidate 251d9ae (21:44:26 +0800, tree 8bc33e49) -> closeout evidence 48b479d (21:58:42 +0800). Candidate mutation set (git diff d36d016..251d9ae, 6 files, +672 lines) equals the card-spec authorized set exactly. The review-job candidateIdentity already recorded baseHead d36d016 / currentHead 251d9ae / changedTreeIdentity ccf6ed16 / patchSha256 7feb7877 — the bundle renderer simply never consumed it.

EVIDENCE (R5): the complete A1-A16 evidence existed (dogfood-evidence.json chain, suite runs, writeback population, CLI proofs) but was not ingested: the bundle's evidence inventory (section 17/18) carries only the graph-closeout snapshot, and negative/regression sections defaulted to (none) — the original runner's result carried only a summary string. This reseal attaches the full machine-readable matrix, suite output, probe results and benchmark as hashed evidence files (sections 17/18) plus negative cases (15) and regression classification (16).

RESEAL GENERATION: surface-reseal (GENERATION_TYPE) — evidence/governance-metadata correction only; touches NO implementation path; REPAIR_BUDGET_USED stays 0; REPAIR_LINEAGE_SURFACE_RESEALS 0 -> 1; supersedes bundle feb69523 (identity + sha preserved, artifact retained, never overwritten).

DELIVERY: Current/ (the canonical external-review surface) is preserved untouched per card requirement (its occupant feb69523 remains AWAITING_EXTERNAL_REVIEW / verdict null; the governed deliverer fail-closes on an unresolved occupant by design). This reseal's trio publishes to the card's own governed surface dir docs/pi-graph-output/cbm-live-integration-1/surface/ (revart-lc1-b2 precedent), with delivery.json recording externalReviewStatus AWAITING_EXTERNAL_REVIEW, verdict null, supersedes=feb69523.
negativeCases: A4 deny: FAST_PATH admission (memory_retrieval_allowed=false) -> no provider; isRetrievalAuthorized false (test-admission-memory-provider A4 PASS).
A6 isolation: query from foreign repository identity (a8d93536) -> excludedRepository=6, zero cross-identity records; own records only visible under own identity (RAW floor, 2 EXECUTION).
A15 corruption: tampered journal -> state INVALID, MEMORY_STORE_INVALID:JOURNAL_CHAIN_INVALID (line 9 not valid JSON), CLI exit 2.
A15 empty: missing store -> EMPTY_MEMORY (valid explicit answer), CLI exit 0 — never silently empty.
A12 non-mutation: 4 concurrent RO CLI queries -> journal.jsonl + memory.db byte-identical (sha256 unchanged).

A8 stale-at-HEAD: records bound to tree 8bc33e49 are excluded at retrieval (selected 0, tree-baseline validity) while current tree c6eefb9f; INCLUDE_STALE surfaces them with provenance — never labeled current.
B-1 environment: OMP scout node_repl sandbox cannot create SQLite WAL sidecars (CANTOPEN) — store verified healthy from normal processes (journal parity true).

regression.suite: PRE-EXISTING: memory contract/retrieval suites (canonical 11, jsonl 12, record-schema 13, security 10, sqlite 14, trust-validity 20, query-schema 11, local-store 18, retrieval 24, snapshot 6, rebuild-determinism 5, retrieval-security 14, graph-context 7)

regressionSummary: 196/196 pass (0 fail) across the 17-suite formal run (serial, --test-concurrency=1). Zero failures -> no INTRODUCED/PRE-EXISTING/ENVIRONMENT_BOUND/UNRELATED classification required; every suite green. CARD-TARGETED suites: 8 tests (A2/A6/A7/A8/A9/A15 x5 + A3/A4/A5 x3). PRE-EXISTING regression: 188 tests (memory 165, admission-gate 10, review-lifecycle 13). Baseline comparison: the same 17 suites passed in the original formal run (bundle claim '196 tests green') — independently re-run here at reseal time; identical outcome.
risks: GENERIC_REVIEW_PROVENANCE_MODEL_GAP: the FM-3 delta-v1 closeout inventory cannot attribute already-committed candidate work (working-tree snapshot model only). Affects ANY card that commits before its formal lifecycle run — not card-specific. Documented here; fix belongs to a dedicated Review Lifecycle provenance card (out of scope for this reseal).

The reseal's own FM-3 delta covers only this reseal's outputs (baseline captured clean at 48b479d); the implementation files remain invisible to section 9 by the same generic gap — the complete mutation provenance is carried in this bundle's evidence files (matrix + probes).
limitations: A11 sub-agent proof subject to the OMP sandbox WAL limitation (B-1); the CLI surface itself is the production query path.

Store freshness: at reseal time the index covers tree 8bc33e49; current tree c6eefb9f (48b479d) is stale-bound by design until the governed writeback re-runs at the new tree (A8/A9 semantics, no watcher).
rollbackProcedure: The superseded bundle feb69523 is retained byte-identical (never overwritten); retire the reseal bundle to .superseded/ or re-run the reseal gate with a corrected contract. Current/ is untouched by this reseal.
